workflows.title: Accept a school invitation

steps.title: School invitation
steps.help: The public invitation identifies the school; child details appear only after the required identity checks.

fields.name: channel
fields.label: I am using the school’s verified invitation channel.

steps.title: Review permitted access
steps.help: The school has already verified the relationship and its allowed purposes.

fields.name: identity
fields.label: The invited identity has been verified through the school’s required process.

fields.name: access
fields.label: I have reviewed the child and permitted purposes.

workflows.outcome: The verified child link becomes active for this account, with its exact permitted purposes.
workflows.invariant: Email possession alone cannot prove a guardian relationship. Bind a single-use invitation to the verified relationship and intended account; never let the parent choose a child or expand grants.
workflows.recovery: Expired, wrong-account, revoked and delivery-failed invitations show safe help. Replaying a completed acceptance returns the existing outcome.
workflows.data: Guardians owns relationship verification/purpose grant; Access owns account and invitation token hash. Atomic acceptance rechecks both before activation.

workflows.title: Sign in through the school page
workflows.purpose: active account; child-purpose authorization after sign-in

steps.title: Sign in
steps.help: Published school branding gives context, not access.

steps.title: Choose a workspace
steps.help: Only currently permitted family contexts appear.

workflows.outcome: The parent enters an authorized family workspace and sees the current child context.
workflows.invariant: No admission-number plus birth-date public child lookup. Account identity and relationship authority remain separate. Safe internal return URLs only.
workflows.recovery: Use generic credential rejection. Empty links lead to school contact; suspended access does not reveal child names.
workflows.data: Access session → active GuardianRelationship/PurposeGrant → minimal permitted child summaries.

workflows.title: Activate or recover account access
workflows.purpose: institution trust mode + account-wide recovery policy

steps.title: Account help
steps.help: Use the recovery channel allowed by the school and every relevant stricter membership.

steps.title: Next step
steps.help: A generic acknowledgement protects account existence.

fields.name: understood
fields.label: I will follow the verified instructions from the school.

workflows.outcome: The parent receives a safe acknowledgement or verified support route.
workflows.invariant: Global account recovery must not bypass a stricter institution. Recheck policy when issuing and consuming a token. Compromised-inbox recovery uses the verified owner route.
workflows.recovery: Expired/revoked/consumed/failed-delivery tokens fail safely. Do not send a second identity’s invitation to a newly entered mailbox.
workflows.data: Access token hash, delivery state, session invalidation and policy evidence; no secrets or raw tokens in logs.

workflows.title: Review my verified child links
workflows.purpose: relationship self-read with purpose-filtered child summary

steps.title: My children
steps.help: A separate grant exists for each child, school and purpose.

steps.title: Access question
steps.help: A relationship label does not imply every capability.

workflows.outcome: The parent understands the children and purposes they can access.
workflows.invariant: No unrestricted household or co-guardian directory. Do not reveal private reasons for restrictions or compare children.
workflows.recovery: Revoked/ended links disappear from protected lists; old deep links fail without leaking details.
workflows.data: GuardianRelationship → effective PurposeGrant → child/enrollment summary, constrained by institution and branch.

workflows.title: Ask about a missing child link
workflows.purpose: authenticated support request; no child-record access

steps.title: Contact the school
steps.help: Submit a claim for verification, not a search across school records.

steps.title: Review request
steps.help: Use the school’s approved identity-verification process.

fields.name: safe
fields.label: I have not included passwords, identity documents or private custody details.

workflows.outcome: A support request is pending verification; no child access is added automatically.
workflows.invariant: Do not confirm whether a named child exists. Only a designated school verifier can establish the relationship and purpose grants.
workflows.recovery: Duplicate request shows prior reference. Missing proof uses a private school channel; an ordinary request is not evidence.
workflows.data: Support claim is owned by Family requests; verified relationship remains a separate Guardians command.

workflows.title: Handle changed or withdrawn access

steps.title: Access changed
steps.help: Show only a safe message and support reference.

steps.title: Leave safely
steps.help: Clear protected screen state when access changes.

fields.name: ack
fields.label: I understand that previous access may no longer be available.

workflows.outcome: Protected child data is cleared and the parent receives a safe next step.
workflows.invariant: Recheck on reads, writes, downloads and delivery. Child-switch caches, search results and back navigation must not retain revoked data.
workflows.recovery: Never expose the private restriction reason, another guardian’s details or a previously authorized attachment.
workflows.data: Access/Guardians revocation event invalidates purpose caches; owner queries enforce current grants independently.

workflows.title: Review my family overview
workflows.purpose: current minimal summary for each active relationship

steps.title: Family overview
steps.help: Summaries are limited to currently permitted children and sources.

steps.title: Next action
steps.help: Every item names its child and school.

workflows.outcome: The parent reaches a relevant action without a school-wide dashboard or sibling comparisons.
workflows.invariant: No combined attendance percentage, combined cross-school payment basket or hidden child counts. Avoid labeling a child as at risk from incomplete data.
workflows.recovery: Partial module failure identifies the unavailable source and last-updated time without inventing a zero.
workflows.data: Compose authorized owner summaries per relationship; all-school counts never enter the parent read model.

workflows.title: Switch child and school context
workflows.purpose: active destination relationship and specific purposes

steps.title: Select a child
steps.help: The child card includes school, branch and class to avoid mistakes.

steps.title: Review unsaved work
steps.help: Records remain attached to their original child.

fields.name: leave
fields.label: I have reviewed any unsent work before switching.

workflows.outcome: The entire workspace switches to the selected child and re-evaluates modules and permissions.
workflows.invariant: No independent branch switch that leaves the previous child selected. Cancel or confirm dirty input; clear prior child view state. Persisted pending payments stay tied to their original invoice.
workflows.recovery: If a destination grant changes, leave the parent in a safe permitted context. Never carry messages, attachments or request drafts across children.
workflows.data: Relationship/child/context DTO drives owner calls. Draft and pending-intent keys include actor, institution, child and purpose.

workflows.title: Manage school notification preferences

steps.title: Choose updates
steps.help: Preferences do not change the underlying access grant.

steps.title: Choose channel
steps.help: Show any school-required service notices separately.

fields.name: review
fields.label: I have reviewed which service notices remain required.

workflows.outcome: Preferences are saved for the selected permitted category and verified channel.
workflows.invariant: An opt-in is not a guardian grant; an opt-out cannot erase an outstanding request or legal/service notice. No sensitive content in push previews.
workflows.recovery: Unverified contact details cannot receive private updates. Record a delivery failure without marking a notice read.
workflows.data: Preferences keyed by actor, child/purpose/category; Communication resolves verified channels and current recipient grants.

workflows.title: Read my child’s attendance

steps.title: Attendance period
steps.help: Read submitted session outcomes in school-local time.

steps.title: Inspect a session
steps.help: Unsubmitted and unavailable are not absence.

workflows.outcome: The parent understands the exact session status and source of the recorded outcome.
workflows.invariant: Show session granularity and exclude unsubmitted/cancelled sessions from any policy-defined attendance denominator. Do not invent a daily status or percentage.
workflows.recovery: Pending data and revised records display honestly. Parent cannot edit marks.
workflows.data: Submitted AttendanceSession → child frozen roster entry → effective AttendanceRecord/revision, scoped to current child purpose.

workflows.title: Submit an absence explanation

steps.title: Absence details
steps.help: This is an explanation for school review, not an attendance mark.

steps.title: School note
steps.help: Share only what the office needs; use restricted channels for sensitive evidence.

fields.name: confirm
fields.label: I understand that the school reviews this explanation separately from attendance.

workflows.outcome: The explanation receives a reference and Pending review status; attendance remains unchanged.
workflows.invariant: Same-day date ranges are valid. Live grant and date/policy bounds apply at submit; duplicate intent is idempotent. No automatic Excused status.
workflows.recovery: Failed save preserves draft. Lost response checks the same request reference. Sensitive documents need the separately approved upload route.
workflows.data: FamilyRequest/AbsenceExplanation references child and dates; Attendance is read-only here. School disposition/correction is a separate owner command.

workflows.title: Track or withdraw an explanation
workflows.purpose: own explanation read/withdraw with current child grant

steps.title: Request status
steps.help: Pending, reviewed and withdrawn have different meaning.

steps.title: Next action
steps.help: The school’s disposition is not automatically an attendance correction.

workflows.outcome: The parent sees a traceable request status or withdrawal outcome.
workflows.invariant: Only an eligible pending request can be withdrawn; use its current version. Never delete the evidence of a reviewed decision.
workflows.recovery: Concurrent school review wins by version; show the new state and safe next action.
workflows.data: Explanation version/status and owner decision reference; append safe audit event, not destructive deletion.

workflows.title: Query an attendance discrepancy

steps.title: Exact session
steps.help: Quote the session the school recorded.

steps.title: Explain the concern
steps.help: The authorized school administrator decides any correction.

workflows.outcome: The parent receives a query reference; the submitted register remains unchanged.
workflows.invariant: No parent attendance.correct grant. A query is not an approved correction or evidence that the teacher was wrong.
workflows.recovery: If the record changed, show the permitted new revision and retain the original query reference.
workflows.data: FamilyRequest references child/session/revision; Attendance correction owner links any accepted outcome.

workflows.title: Read and acknowledge a school notice
workflows.purpose: notice audience grant for this account/child

steps.title: Read the notice
steps.help: Show the published version and the child/school audience.

steps.title: Acknowledge
steps.help: Acknowledgement requires a deliberate action.

workflows.outcome: The exact published notice version is acknowledged with a timestamp.
workflows.invariant: Read, delivered and acknowledged are separate. Editing a notice may require a new acknowledgement; an open page is not consent.
workflows.recovery: Withdrawn/changed notice or revoked audience cannot be silently acknowledged.
workflows.data: Notice/version + audience snapshot + explicit AccountAcknowledgement; recheck current grant on attachment access.

workflows.title: Reply to a permitted conversation

steps.title: Conversation
steps.help: Use the school-approved child-specific thread.

steps.title: Reply
steps.help: Do not include other pupils or private family restrictions.

workflows.outcome: The reply has its real sending/delivery state in the permitted thread.
workflows.invariant: Recipient identities are server-resolved. No unrestricted teacher address book or co-guardian visibility. Parent cannot add participants.
workflows.recovery: Access removed before send stops delivery. Failed or unknown send remains distinct from sent; reconcile before retry.
workflows.data: ConversationGrant → Message → delivery attempt, bound to selected child and live participants.

workflows.title: Request a teacher meeting

steps.title: Meeting purpose
steps.help: Choose a school-offered channel and participant.

steps.title: Preferred time
steps.help: A request is not a confirmed calendar booking.

workflows.outcome: The request is pending, then confirmed/rescheduled/declined by the school.
workflows.invariant: Use offered availability only. Do not expose staff private calendars. Store school-local zone and an unambiguous instant after confirmation.
workflows.recovery: Handle competing reservations, cancellation and removed guardian access.
workflows.data: Proposed MeetingRequest/SlotReservation; Communication owns participant notifications. Requires scheduling LLD.

workflows.title: Resolve an undelivered message
workflows.purpose: own message read + live conversation grant

steps.title: Delivery status
steps.help: A failed delivery does not become a sent message.

steps.title: Recovery
steps.help: Recheck status before repeating an uncertain request.

fields.name: action
fields.label: Action
options: Contact the school through an approved channel

workflows.outcome: The parent knows whether a message was accepted, failed or remains unknown.
workflows.invariant: Keep one stable message identity; delivery attempts are separate and grant-checked. Never retry to a removed recipient.
workflows.recovery: Provider acknowledgement is not human reading. Show a safe failure reason without delivery credentials.
workflows.data: Message intent → DeliveryAttempt status, idempotent retry policy and current ConversationGrant.

workflows.title: Plan with the school calendar

steps.title: Calendar
steps.help: See school-local dates and the source school.

steps.title: Event detail
steps.help: A dated event is not proof of attendance or a transport reservation.

workflows.outcome: The parent can plan using a readable agenda and current published event version.
workflows.invariant: Calendar export contains only permitted minimal details. No other child or staff-private schedule.
workflows.recovery: Changed/cancelled events show clear history; stale export does not override the live school record.
workflows.data: Published calendar event/version + audience purpose; export generation reauthorizes each event.

workflows.title: Respond to a school event

steps.title: Event response
steps.help: Review the event and its response deadline.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.help: RSVP and permission consent are separate.

fields.name: confirm
fields.label: I have checked the selected child and event response.

workflows.outcome: An explicit response is recorded for this event version.
workflows.invariant: RSVP does not grant excursion consent, pickup authority or paid-service enrollment. If a separate consent is needed, show it separately.
workflows.recovery: Deadline passed, event version changed or capacity changed yields a clear outcome.
workflows.data: Proposed EventResponse, event version and owner capacity policy; Consent and Finance remain separate owners.

workflows.title: Review published homework

steps.title: Assignment
steps.help: Read the teacher’s published task and deadline.

steps.title: Support the child
steps.help: The student remains the author of submitted work.

workflows.outcome: The guardian understands the task, deadline and current learner submission state.
workflows.invariant: No submit-as-child or mark-as-complete shortcut unless a separately approved assisted-submission policy exists. Draft tasks are private.
workflows.recovery: Missing and late are distinct; no submission is not proof of non-learning. Reauthorize attachments.
workflows.data: Published Assignment/version → child audience/enrollment → minimal SubmissionStatus, with no unrelated classmates.

workflows.title: Read returned learning feedback

steps.title: Returned feedback
steps.help: Only feedback intentionally returned to the permitted audience appears.

steps.title: Support next steps
steps.help: Separate the teacher’s feedback from automated interpretation.

workflows.outcome: The parent sees the returned revision and can support its next step.
workflows.invariant: Private draft feedback, moderation notes and unrelated student work never appear.
workflows.recovery: Withdrawn/replaced feedback identifies the permitted current version; authorization applies to historical versions too.
workflows.data: FeedbackRevision returned state + guardian learning purpose + submission/task references.

workflows.title: Ask a learning question

steps.title: Learning context
steps.help: Quote the relevant assignment, not a class-wide pupil list.

steps.title: Question
steps.help: Use the permitted teacher conversation.

workflows.outcome: The question is routed to a permitted conversation with the child context attached.
workflows.invariant: No unrestricted new recipient selection or implicit result-appeal workflow.
workflows.recovery: If the teacher’s assignment changes, the school resolves routing without exposing another private thread.
workflows.data: Communication message references a permitted Learning resource/version; each owner rechecks its scope.

workflows.title: Read published results

steps.title: Published report
steps.help: Choose a published reporting period.

steps.title: Understand outcomes
steps.help: Show the scheme, scale and teacher comments that were approved for release.

workflows.outcome: The parent understands the official published result version.
workflows.invariant: Unentered, Absent and Exempt do not become zero. Draft marks/moderation are excluded. No sibling/class ranking by default.
workflows.recovery: Withheld, unpublished, superseded and unavailable have different user messages without leaking private reasons.
workflows.data: PublishedResultVersion → child’s approved outcomes + SchemeVersion and permitted comments.

workflows.title: Download an authorized report

steps.title: Report version
steps.help: Choose the exact published report.

steps.title: Download
steps.help: Confirm the device and intended child.

fields.name: device
fields.label: I am using a device suitable for this child’s school records.

workflows.outcome: A permitted report download is issued and its version is clear.
workflows.invariant: Authorize every download; use short-lived delivery links. URLs are not permanent authorization. No other child in filenames or shared caches.
workflows.recovery: Revoked access or superseded report requires a fresh authorized request.
workflows.data: Document owner references immutable published result version; audit only minimal download metadata.

workflows.title: Request a result clarification

steps.title: Result context
steps.help: A clarification does not change a published mark.

steps.title: Question
steps.help: The assessment owner follows the school’s review process.

workflows.outcome: A tracked clarification reaches the authorized school reviewer.
workflows.invariant: No direct parent grade edits, guaranteed revaluation or automatic publication of revised results.
workflows.recovery: Closed review window, duplicate query and a superseded result produce clear next steps.
workflows.data: FamilyRequest references PublishedResultVersion/subject; Assessments owns any correction and republication.

workflows.title: Review a child’s fee invoice

steps.title: Invoice
steps.help: Review the issuing institution, invoice and currency.

steps.title: Breakdown
steps.help: Distinguish charges, adjustments, receipts and outstanding balance.

workflows.outcome: The payer understands the exact payable balance for one issuing institution.
workflows.invariant: Guardian status alone does not grant fee or payer access. No cross-school combined basket. Never expose another payer’s private banking details.
workflows.recovery: Disputed/adjusted invoice, stale balance or disabled online payment remains reviewable only under current grant.
workflows.data: Finance Invoice/version → line items/adjustments → allocated settled payments. All money uses currency and exact minor units.

workflows.title: Pay an authorized invoice

steps.title: Payment review
steps.help: Confirm the invoice, child, merchant institution and exact amount.

fields.name: amount
fields.label: I have checked the displayed currency and exact amount.

steps.title: Payment handoff
steps.help: A provider redirect is not proof of settlement.

fields.name: provider
fields.label: I understand that the receipt is issued only after verified confirmation.

workflows.outcome: One payment order is created; the result is Processing, Paid, Failed or Unknown until reconciled.
workflows.invariant: Server computes amount and issuer from the current invoice. Stable idempotency key, invoice version and payable-state guard prevent duplicate orders. Never collect card details in this portal.
workflows.recovery: Changed balance requires re-review. Interrupted redirect or pending provider outcome uses Check status before any new payment.
workflows.data: PaymentOrder → PaymentAttempt → verified provider event/reconciliation → ledger allocation/receipt in Finance. Prototype never contacts a provider.

workflows.title: Resolve an uncertain payment
workflows.purpose: own payment status + current payer/read purpose

steps.title: Payment status
steps.help: Do not ask the parent to pay again while the result is unknown.

steps.title: Resolve
steps.help: Provider confirmation must be verified by the server.

workflows.outcome: The existing order is resolved or remains visibly pending without another charge attempt.
workflows.invariant: Client callback, screenshot or success query parameter cannot mark an invoice Paid. Only verified settlement evidence changes the ledger.
workflows.recovery: A pending order persists across navigation. Repeated status reads are safe; retries only after a definitive owner-approved failure state.
workflows.data: PaymentAttempt status and provider event deduplication; Finance ledger allocation is atomic and idempotent.

workflows.title: Read receipts and payment history

steps.title: Payment history
steps.help: Filter by the permitted child and issuing school.

steps.title: Receipt
steps.help: A receipt belongs to a confirmed payment allocation.

workflows.outcome: The parent can reconcile the invoice and a verified receipt.
workflows.invariant: Pending orders do not produce settled receipts. A receipt identifies currency, issuer, amount, date and masked references only.
workflows.recovery: Refunds/adjustments show a linked traceable event; a PDF download failure does not repeat the payment.
workflows.data: Settled PaymentAllocation → Receipt/version plus safe PaymentAttempt history; downloads reauthorize.

workflows.title: Raise a fee or refund query

steps.title: Query context
steps.help: A request is not an approved refund or adjustment.

steps.title: Explain
steps.help: Share only the transaction reference the school needs.

workflows.outcome: A financial query is tracked separately from settlement and approval.
workflows.invariant: No parent refund execution, auto-writeoff or trusted uploaded payment screenshot. Authorized finance review controls any ledger effect.
workflows.recovery: Duplicate queries link to existing case. Keep Pending review distinct from Refund initiated and Refunded.
workflows.data: FinanceCase references invoice/payment; approval, provider refund event and ledger adjustment are separate owner transactions.

workflows.title: Ask about payer access
workflows.purpose: support claim; no self-grant of finance authority

steps.title: Payer access
steps.help: An emergency contact or guardian is not automatically a payer.

steps.title: School verification
steps.help: Use the school’s verified payer process.

workflows.outcome: The finance/relationship owner reviews a purpose-specific access request.
workflows.invariant: A payer-only contact must not gain academic or health access. No parent can add another payer or inherit their banking records.
workflows.recovery: Changed mandate invalidates pending payer actions and rechecks owner-controlled in-flight obligations.
workflows.data: PayerMandate/PurposeGrant remains owner controlled; FamilyRequest stores the claim and decision reference.

workflows.title: Submit a school request

steps.title: Request category
steps.help: Show only school-enabled categories.

steps.title: Details
steps.help: Avoid private evidence in a general request.

fields.name: safe
fields.label: I have kept sensitive evidence out of this general request.

workflows.outcome: A reference and Pending review state make the next step clear.
workflows.invariant: Submission is not approval, a correction or a service booking. Category routing and visibility are school configured.
workflows.recovery: Save failure keeps input; duplicate intent returns the existing reference; unknown outcome checks the same request.
workflows.data: FamilyRequest with actor/child/category/version/status and private owner routing; minimal audit metadata.

workflows.title: Track or withdraw a school request

steps.title: Request history
steps.help: Read only requests this account may see.

steps.title: Action
steps.help: Withdrawing a request is not deleting its history.

workflows.outcome: The parent sees the current owner decision and eligible next actions.
workflows.invariant: A co-guardian does not automatically see another guardian’s private request. Use originator plus purpose policy, not household equality.
workflows.recovery: Concurrent review, completed request or removed authority returns a safe conflict instead of overwriting the decision.
workflows.data: FamilyRequest/version + eligible actor visibility; append a transition and preserve owner response.

workflows.title: Request a child-record update
workflows.purpose: record-change request; no direct master-data write

steps.title: What changed?
steps.help: The school verifies changes to official records.

steps.title: Request details
steps.help: Identity evidence uses the school’s restricted verification route.

fields.name: verify
fields.label: I understand that the school will verify the change.

workflows.outcome: A pending change request is linked to the student record, without editing it directly.
workflows.invariant: No direct legal-name, custody, enrollment or guardian-grant edits. Account contact and child master data are different workflows.
workflows.recovery: Reject stale/disallowed edits safely; approved change has its own owner event/version.
workflows.data: ChangeRequest references Student/Person field category; Students/Guardians owner applies verified changes.

workflows.title: Request a school document

steps.title: Document type
steps.help: Only school-offered documents appear.

steps.title: Purpose
steps.help: The school verifies eligibility and any approval requirement.

workflows.outcome: The request progresses to approved/declined/issued, then an authorized download.
workflows.invariant: Request receipt is not an issued certificate. Templates, signatory authority, retention and any fee depend on the document owner.
workflows.recovery: Expired/revoked links require reauthorization. Keep approval and document-generation failures distinct.
workflows.data: DocumentRequest → approved versioned artifact; explicit child/purpose access at generation and download.

workflows.title: Respond to a permission or consent form

steps.title: Read the request
steps.help: Review the exact purpose, scope, dates and document version.

steps.title: Your decision
steps.help: Choices are unselected until a deliberate decision.

fields.name: read
fields.label: I have read this version of the information.

workflows.outcome: An explicit decision records signer, child, purpose, document version and time.
workflows.invariant: No preselected consent, bundled unrelated purposes or assumption that every guardian may sign alone. School policy defines required signers and withdrawal effects.
workflows.recovery: Changed form, deadline passed or signer grant removed requires a safe re-review. Withdrawal is a separate traceable decision when policy allows.
workflows.data: ConsentRequest/version + SignerPolicy + immutable ConsentDecision; one guardian’s response cannot satisfy an unfulfilled second-signature requirement.

workflows.title: Start or resume an application
workflows.purpose: applicant self-scope; separate from enrolled child grant

steps.title: Application
steps.help: Use the school’s offered intake and a minimal applicant record.

steps.title: Save or submit
steps.help: A submitted application is not enrollment or portal access.

fields.name: truth
fields.label: I have reviewed the information for accuracy.

workflows.outcome: An applicant-scoped draft or submitted application has a reference.
workflows.invariant: An applicant is not matched to an existing pupil by email/DOB alone. Keep evidence, fee and relationship verification separate.
workflows.recovery: Duplicate claims, withdrawal, document failure and intake closure do not create student records automatically.
workflows.data: Admissions Application/version/owner actor; approved admission later invokes verified Students/Guardians onboarding.

workflows.title: Track application requirements
workflows.purpose: own application read + allowed evidence upload

steps.title: Application checklist
steps.help: See only school-requested items and status.

steps.title: Respond
steps.help: Use restricted evidence handling and retain a clear receipt.

workflows.outcome: The applicant understands what remains outstanding and the school’s next decision.
workflows.invariant: Evidence is not a public attachment or ordinary message. File size/type/scan policy and review access must be defined before implementation.
workflows.recovery: Rejected evidence has a safe reason and resubmission path; do not erase previously reviewed versions.
workflows.data: ApplicationRequirement → evidence artifact/version → school disposition; object access is purpose scoped.

workflows.title: Respond to an admission offer

steps.title: Offer
steps.help: Review the school, intake, conditions and response deadline.

steps.title: Decision
steps.help: Acceptance is distinct from enrollment completion.

fields.name: terms
fields.label: I have reviewed the offer conditions.

workflows.outcome: The response is recorded and remaining enrollment steps are visible.
workflows.invariant: Offer acceptance cannot independently create a verified guardian relationship, settle a fee or assign a class.
workflows.recovery: Expired/superseded offer, pending payment or missing evidence leads to a precise incomplete state.
workflows.data: Offer/version → response; admission completion orchestrates separate approved enrollment and guardian commands.

workflows.title: Review transport assignment

steps.title: Route assignment
steps.help: Only the child’s active route and stop are visible.

steps.title: Service question
steps.help: A request does not change the transport route.

fields.name: next
fields.label: Next action
options: Request a stop or service change

workflows.outcome: The parent knows the currently assigned route and how to request a change.
workflows.invariant: No full passenger list, unrelated stops, driver private contact or other child location.
workflows.recovery: Unassigned/suspended service, route change and service disruption are distinct.
workflows.data: TransportAssignment/effective dates → Route/Stop minimal projection; transport owner decides capacity and change.

workflows.title: Request an authorized pickup change

steps.title: Pickup request
steps.help: The school verifies temporary collection authority.

steps.title: Confirm request
steps.help: This is not an immediate gate pass.

fields.name: confirm
fields.label: I understand that school verification and approval are required.

workflows.outcome: A pending pickup request has a dated approval/decline outcome.
